not_implemented - control does not exist. Recorded honestly. 'tests' empty.
deliberately_absent - the code intentionally does NOT provide this control;
unverified   - not yet re-verified to the CAPA-001 standard. Must not be
recorded as VERIFIED in the RMF until it is.

The 3.0 mm3 floor is re-anchored to MSSEG-2016's evaluation gate and explicitly NOT the 3 mm-DIAMETER (~14 mm3) diagnostic criterion (the old '~3 voxels' justification was conflatable and is removed); the duplicated literal is consolidated.
